design_strategy.vibe: Clean bright Trello-like workspace with crisp information architecture, high legibility, and delightful micro-interactions

image_urls.description: Clean desk setup with kanban board

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust Kanban Task Board full-stack application with Node.js/Express + SQLite backend and interactive frontend in HTML/Vanilla JS with fetch API calls. Ensure JWT auth, Board CRUD with default columns (To Do, In Progress, Done), Column CRUD (with delete policy choice: delete tasks or move to To Do), Task CRUD, drag-and-drop with position persistence, member management by email, comments on tasks, and keyword/priority/assignee filtering. All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Never use complete transparent background in headers or overlays.
Use generous spacing, clear typography hierarchy, and accessible contrast.
Ensure smooth DOM updates on fetch calls without full page reloads.
Implement drag-and-drop with persistent position saving.
